turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! In a simple English statement, the order is subject, verb, object, with place or time at the end. Frequency words like always, usually and never go before the main verb.

Put these words in order to make a sentence: "often / my aunt / tea / makes"
